summary: Source-anchored research for maxEstimatedScanBytes collection-scan rejection (9.0). Run status: COMPLETED.

facts.text: Introduced in MongoDB 9.0, maxEstimatedScanBytes rejects an unbounded COLLSCAN during planning when the collection's logical size exceeds the configured threshold; rejection returns NoQueryExecutionPlans. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30)

An effective positive limit exempts a scan from rejection. The planner calls hasEffectiveLimit; this exemption should not be generalized into a runtime byte budget or a guarantee that every downstream pipeline limit bounds scan work. (medium confidence)

The serverStatus metrics distinguish rejected, rejectedAndOverridden, and dryRunWouldReject. Effective-limit exemptions are not counted as $natural overrides; SERVER-133721 closed the proposal to count them as Works as Designed. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-09-25) Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/serverStatus/ ; https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-133721

TOOLS-4313 documents that plain mongoexport can fail after an operator enables the threshold, while skip and projection alone do not avoid rejection. The fix adds a $natural hint only when no query and no sort were supplied; the issue lists Database Tools 100.18.0 as the fix version. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-09-02)

SERVER-130688 documents rooted-$or classic subplanning incrementing rejection-related counters twice for one query on a development build; it lists a fix in 9.1.0-rc0. This is a historical metrics-accuracy caveat, not evidence that all released 9.0 builds are affected. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-07-17)

SERVER-135593 records a follow-up fix to rate-limit rejection logging, with fix versions 9.1.0-rc0 and 9.1.0-rc1024. Current master planner code suppresses repeated logs per namespace within a one-second window; master behavior is not proof of a 9.0 backport. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) Sources: https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-135593 ; https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/master/src/mongo/db/query/query_planner.cpp

Effective $limit exemptions do not increment rejectedAndOverridden. SERVER-133721 requested counting them but closed as Works as Designed; that counter should not be interpreted as all exempt queries. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-09-25) Sources: https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-133721 ; https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/parameters.md

The documented mongoexport reproduction still rejects --skip, --fields, and an unindexed sort; --limit and index-served queries or sorts pass. The selective hint fix intentionally leaves unindexed sorts subject to rejection. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-09-02)

The threshold uses uncompressed logical bytes, equivalent to collStats.size, rather than compressed disk usage. It is an estimate used before execution, not a measured runtime byte quota. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)

The mongod integer parameter defaults to -1 (disabled). Configure it at startup with --setParameter maxEstimatedScanBytes=<int>, or at runtime with db.adminCommand({setParameter:1,maxEstimatedScanBytes:<int>}). (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)
Indexed plans and internal namespaces are exempt; bounded clustered scans with min/max record bounds are also exempt. (low confidence)

An explicit $natural hint permits an intentional full collection scan above the threshold. serverStatus.metrics.query.maxEstimatedScanBytes.rejectedAndOverridden records these overrides. (medium confidence) Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/parameters.md ; https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/serverStatus/

The manual additionally subjects $lookup join strategies to the threshold on the foreign collection, except indexed nested-loop joins; the feature's scope extends beyond a top-level find scan. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)

maxEstimatedScanBytesDryRun defaults to false. Setting it true permits otherwise rejected queries while logging them and incrementing metrics.query.maxEstimatedScanBytes.dryRunWouldReject; use this to assess a threshold before enforcement. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)

TOOLS-4312 documents failures in unfiltered mongodump and in the view CountDocuments path. The issue lists Database Tools 100.18.0 as the fix version; current mongodump source explicitly hints unfiltered dumps with $natural while preserving filtered queries. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) Sources: https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/TOOLS-4312 ; https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo-tools/master/mongodump/mongodump.go
SERVER-134664 reports missing default-verbosity rejection logging. Its issue lists fix versions 9.1.0-rc0, 9.1.0-rc1024 and 9.0.7. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30)

Indexed plans and effective positive limits avoid this rejection. The planner also exempts bounded clustered scans; the manual lists internal namespaces as exempt. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)

An explicit $natural hint bypasses the guardrail for an intentional collection scan. It can exclude otherwise usable indexes, so applying it indiscriminately can worsen query plans. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30)

serverStatus.metrics.query.maxEstimatedScanBytes separates rejected queries, rejectedAndOverridden queries allowed by $natural, and dryRunWouldReject queries allowed by dry-run mode. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30)

TOOLS-4312 and TOOLS-4313 record mongodump and mongoexport scan failures after operators enable the guardrail. Both list fix version 100.18.0 and use selective $natural hints for intentional unfiltered scans. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-09-02) Sources: https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/TOOLS-4312 ; https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/TOOLS-4313

Rejection logging changed after the initial feature: SERVER-134664 addresses missing default-verbosity messages, and SERVER-135593 adds rate limiting. Current master uses a namespace-keyed severity suppressor; master does not establish behavior in every 9.0 patch. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) Sources: https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-134664 ; https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-135593 ; https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/master/src/mongo/db/query/query_planner.cpp
